products.priceNote: The maker's page quotes no amount. It asks for a quote. No price is recorded, and none is inferred: a quote-only product with a zero in it would read as free.
products.description: One-person far infrared cabin sold by quote rather than at a listed price.
caveats: The page states a heater surface temperature. That is not the temperature of the cabin, and no cabin temperature is recorded from it.
The warranty on this page is stated per component. It is not a blanket lifetime warranty and is not recorded as one.

The page is on the maker's own domain and was read as the maker speaking. Whether "Atlas" names a separate company from SaunaCloud is not established here, so the brand record carries the name on the domain that was read.
